exposure: Gestational age at induction (39 weeks, 40 weeks, 41 weeks)
cohort: Women with prior cesarean delivery undergoing either elective induction of labor or expectant management
finding: Patients undergoing elective induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation had an increased risk of uterine rupture compared to expectant management, with fewer successful vaginal births after cesarean (VBAC).
mod_finding: Patients undergoing elective induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation had an increased risk of uterine rupture compared to expectant management, with fewer successful vaginal births after cesarean (VBAC).
